messages:
mira: Heads-up — VentureWorks usage down ~48% last 7d after onboarding handoff. Quick chart here: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/ventwrk (see /chat and /embed-billboard drops).

tyler: Noted. Onboarding runbook shows SSO changes rolled 2025-03-10. We didn't get a final SSO test sign-off from them.

sanjay: AE here — Procurement pinged me this morning, they're evaluating a competitor demo next Tue. Need an action plan to avoid churn.

anya: I can pull token-level breakdown + latency by route. @mira can you confirm which routes are business-critical?

mira: Critical: `POST /v1/chat` (most traffic), `POST /v1/embeddings` (high-volume), and a bespoke rerank job hitting dedicated queue.

tyler: I saw a small spike of 502s and `unauthorized` errors right after the SSO cutover — time ~2025-03-11 03:12Z. Logs attached in the doc.

mira: Elena reported sessions failing intermittently — quote from her: "chat latency doubled and some calls 401'd intermittently". She's looped on thread.

sanjay: Proposed immediate plays:
1) Short rollback/mitigation for SSO or emergency fallback to API keys for a critical service account.
2) Offer a 2-week dedicated burst pool (we can model cost) to stabilize latency.
3) Schedule an exec brief with Elena + their procurement this Wed. Need slides with ROI delta.

anya: I'll assemble a cost delta for the burst pool and expected SLA uplift numbers by EOD. Will also export per-route latency percentiles.

tyler: I can run a hitless rollback rehearsal in staging and prep a canary plan. Who's the technical contact at VentureWorks? @mira please intro.

mira: Intro sent to Elena (cc’ed). Also uploaded a short timeline and suspicious auth errors to the shared folder.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-20250311-VENTWRK-AUTH for auth spikes and elevated error rate. Pager duty notified.

sanjay: Assigning next steps: @tyler — rollback rehearsals + canary (owner). @anya — cost/SLA numbers (owner). @mira — customer intro + exec brief scheduling (owner). I'll draft executive ROI slides.

mira: Thanks — will follow up after the exec brief. If canary shows rollback safe, we'll push temporary keys as fallback until SSO root cause is fixed.

tyler: Quick ask — do we have runbook steps for temporary API-key fallback? If not, I'll draft a condensed one and post here.

anya: I pulled last 14d usage and tagged the seats that dropped. Sending CSV in DM to the thread owners.

sanjay: Good. Aim to present mitigations and cost delta Tue AM to avoid competitor demo next Tue. :thumbsup:

mira: Agree — pulling a short customer-facing note to calm procurement and show an immediate mitigation plan. Will post after the brief.
